div.head: VI Atr 25.2
div.ab: ⁊ gif hwa oðrum scyle borh oððe bote æt woroldlican þingan, gelæste hit him georne ær oððon æfter.
And gif hwa oðrum scule borh oððe bote æt worldlican þingan, gelæste hit him georne ær oððe æfter.
⁊ gif hwa oðrum scyle borh oððe bote æt woroldlican þingan, gelæste hit him georne ær oððon æfter.
And gif hwa oðrum scyle borh oððe bote æt woroldlican þingan, gelæste hit him georne ær oððon æfter.
Und wenn einer dem andern Geborgtes oder Bussgeld aus weltlichen Beziehungen schuldet, zahle er es ihm willig vor oder nach [dem Feste].
And if anyone owes another a loan or compensation in secular matters, let him pay it to him willingly before or after [the feast].
And if anyone owes another a debt or compensation in connection with secular matters, he shall render it to him readily either before or after [the festival].
And if anyone must pay a debt or compensation to another because of a worldly matter, he is to do so promptly before or after the feast.

note.label: repeated
note.quote: a passing demand by Wulfstan, repeated in three texts, that worldly debts not be settled on holy festivals
